text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
choice_data_list: You're full of energy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I listened to a lot of radio yesterday
and got to relax completely!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: There's something about the unique sound waves of radio... That sound you just don't get from TV feels so soothing♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I know!!
Why don't we go listen together next time?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I've been working hard at around 160 miles a day, after all.
I need to relax and recharge once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring it to the trainer's room tonight!
Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed Gran Alegria was able to spend a fulfilling day off!
